title: design-kb: activity patterns
description: Pedagogical constructs the AI proposes activities IN TERMS OF, then realises through palette components. Covers formative activities and assessment-type activities (SUMM and future activity-based summative variants). A pattern is pedagogy; a component is mechanism; a slot is location — proposals cite all three. Summative patterns must calibrate to the tier parity standard (tier-spec §7) via tier-bands pointers.

name.description: e.g. commit-then-reveal retrieval practice; scenario-based application; case analysis; staged synthesis task.

description.description: One short paragraph: what the learner does and why it works. Depth lives in the prose pointer.

recognition.description: How a designer identifies this pattern in source material — what to look for in the content that signals this pattern applies.

realisations.description: How this pattern is built: which components serve it and any register note (FC-2 style: register may live in instruction text, not config).

slotTypes.description: Which archetype slot types this pattern fills (worked-example, check, summative-item, interior-content...).

tierCalibration.description: Per-tier fit and pitch notes; summative patterns MUST point at the §7 parity row via tier-bands.

contextAffinity.description: How this pattern takes context (S1-D2/D3 hooks feed on this).

variationTypes.description: Which coupling depths the pattern supports — case analysis wants whole-prose source material; a definitional check may only tokenise.

benefitsFromFacets.description: Facets whose presence should trigger proposing this pattern with sourced material (e.g. module present -> case-analysis against the module's own docs).

summative.description: Present when intent includes summative. Future activity-based SUMM incarnations = a new summative-page archetype in skeletons PAIRED with patterns here; this object carries the pattern side.

scoringModel.description: How attempts score/complete; pointer-level, detail in prose.

parityNote.description: How the §7 parity check applies to this pattern across contexts.

furnitureCompatibility.description: Standard SUMM furniture this pattern works with (resultsdebrief, passreveal) or is incompatible with — incompatibilities are design flags for the S gate.

servesShapes.description: Which content-shapes (design-kb.content-shapes.json) this pattern serves. Optional: a pattern that samples outcomes rather than a shape (e.g. summative-mixed) leaves it out.
